full_name: VA-13 (formerly Blind Rehabilitation Service Follow-up Outcomes Survey)
domains: tasks linked to the four VA blind rehabilitation domains (Low Vision; Orientation and Mobility; Living Skills; Manual Skills); also frequency and satisfaction items not analysed
response_scale: 1-3 (1 = great deal of assistance; 2 = little assistance; 3 = no assistance/independent) for current and retrospective pre-rehabilitation ability
scoring: raw sum; change score = posttest minus retrospective pretest; Rasch rating scale logits
validation_method: Rasch; CTT; factor analysis; internal consistency
target_population: legally blind veterans after inpatient blind rehabilitation
notes: Telephone administration by research staff 4-6 weeks post-discharge (p2). Posttest person reliability 0.27; Cronbach alpha 0.81 pretest and 0.76 posttest (p6); person separation 1.57 and 0.60 (p7). Ceiling effect.

full_name: Functional Assessment of Self-Reliance on Tasks
domains: 11 goal-level activity categories e.g. Food Preparation, Home Maintenance, Fine Motor/Dexterity, Reading
response_scale: 1-10 clinician rating (1 unable/danger to self; 10 excellent skills completely independent)
scoring: clinician team consensus; Rasch rating scale logits
validation_method: Rasch; CTT; factor analysis; internal consistency
target_population: legally blind veterans in inpatient blind rehabilitation
notes: Text says 11 items (p2); Table p10 lists 10 items. Person reliability 0.90 pretest and 0.85 posttest; separation 2.95 and 2.37 (p8). Clinician-rated, not self-report
